description:
We are a creative and passionate team excited about space, technology, and solving real-world problems. We enjoy combining creativity, research, design, and technology to turn ideas into meaningful projects.

🌍 We’re looking for enthusiastic participants— curiosity, teamwork, and a willingness to learn are just as important!
summary:
STILL OUT HERE is an educational website created to help children explore the Moon and Mars and learn about the machines and objects that humans have left behind in space.
Many robots, rovers, landers and other objects have been sent to the Moon and Mars to explore these places. Some of these machines have completed their missions, but their stories are still important.
Our website helps children discover these forgotten explorers, learn what they did, where they are now and what they discovered.
We use simple stories, pictures and interactive learning to make space science fun and easy to understand.
Our main goal is to inspire children to become curious about space, science and future exploration.
details:
STILL OUT HERE is designed to make space learning interesting, simple and enjoyable for children.

Our website focuses on the Moon and Mars.

It includes:

  1. The Machines: Children can learn about the rovers, robots and landers sent to the Moon and Mars.
  2. Interactive Map: Children can explore different locations and discover where space machines and objects were left behind.
  3. Gallery: Visitors can see pictures and explore the history of different space missions.
  4. Learning Through Stories: We explain space discoveries in simple words so children can understand them easily.
  5. Space Awareness: Children learn about the importance of space exploration and how scientists study other planets.

Our project connects science, technology and storytelling in one educational website.

We hope it encourages children to ask questions, explore new ideas and develop an interest in science.
